<b>Greyroot</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are a root-like being residing within [[Shellwood]]. They offer the <i>[[Rite of the Pollip]]</i> and <i>[[Rite of Rebirth]]</i> [[wishes]].

== Background ==
Greyroot is a root-like being that resides in the core of [[Shellwood]]. In the past, many travelers have visited Greyroot, bringing them the [[Twisted Bud]] as an offering, but none were ever seen again afterwards,<ref>[[Pavo]]: <i>"Aye, yes! Not your own specimen, surely, but way back, other travellers did sometimes carry similar. Odd types they all were. Offerings they'd call the crying things, and towards the core of Shellwood they would trek.
Never I did see one again, not the buds nor the bugs that brought the gift..."</i></ref><ref name="Many">Greyroot: <i>"None... none come now. Once times, many bugs. Many. Now none."</i></ref> after being kidnapped and taken to the [[Shellwood#Sub-area:_Chapel_of_the_Witch|Chapel of the Witch]] - before being subsequently petrified. Greyroot no longer has any visitors.<ref name=Many/>

==In-Game Events==
After speaking to Greyroot in Shellwood, they offer the Wish <i>[[Rite of the Pollip]]</i>. Upon completing the wish, they give the [[Pollip Pouch]].

The [[Twisted Bud]] can be given to Greyroot to begin the Wish <i>[[Rite of Rebirth]]</i>. Completing this wish causes Hornet to become infected with a [[Witch_Crest#Cursed_Crest|parasite]]. Removing the parasite by completing the <i>[[Infestation Operation]]</i> wish replaces it with the [[Witch Crest]].

After <i>Rite of Rebirth</i> is completed, returning to Greyroot's home reveals that they have entered a petrified state and can no longer be spoken to. Their body can be destroyed by attacking it with the Needle. Their body remains destroyed after leaving the room.
